H205.gloss: affliction, evil, false, idol, iniquity, mischief, mourners(-ing), naught, sorrow, unjust, unrighteous, vain, vanity, wicked(-ness). Compare H369 (אַיִן).
H205.def: strictly nothingness; also trouble. vanity, wickedness; specifically an idol

H206.gloss: Aven. See also H204 (אוֹן), H1007 (בֵּית אָוֶן).

H208.def: Onam, the name of an Edomite and of an Israelite

H211.def: Ophir, the name of a son of Joktan, and of a gold region in the East

H215.gloss: [idiom] break of day, glorious, kindle, (be, en-, give, show) light (-en, -ened), set on fire, shine.

H216.gloss: bright, clear, [phrase] day, light (-ning), morning, sun.
H216.def: illumination or (concrete) luminary (in every sense, including lightning, happiness, etc.)

H217.def: flame; hence (in the plural) the East (as being the region of light)

H221.def: Uri, the name of three Israelites

H222.def: Uriel, the name of two Israelites

H227.gloss: beginning, for, from, hitherto, now, of old, once, since, then, at which time, yet.

H235.gloss: fail, gad about, go to and fro (but in Ezekiel 27:19 the word is rendered by many 'from Uzal,' by others 'yarn'), be gone (spent).

H237.def: Ezel, a memorial stone in Palestine

H238.gloss: give (perceive by the) ear, hear(-ken). See H239 (אָזַן).

H240.def: a spade or paddle (as having a broad end)

H241.gloss: [phrase] advertise, audience, [phrase] displease, ear, hearing, [phrase] show.

H249.gloss: bay tree, (home-) born (in the land), of the (one's own) country (nation).

H251.gloss: another, brother(-ly); kindred, like, other. Compare also the proper names beginning with 'Ah-' or 'Ahi-'.
H251.def: a brother (used in the widest sense of literal relationship and metaphorical affinity or resemblance (like father))

H252.def: {a brother (used in the widest sense of literal relationship and metaphorical affinity or resemblance)}

H255.def: a howler or lonesome wild animal

H256.def: Achab, the name of a king of Israel and of a prophet at Babylon

H259.gloss: a, alike, alone, altogether, and, any(-thing), apiece, a certain, (dai-) ly, each (one), [phrase] eleven, every, few, first, [phrase] highway, a man, once, one, only, other, some, together,
H259.def: properly, united, i.e. one; or (as an ordinal) first

H260.def: a bulrush or any marshy grass (particularly that along the Nile)

H261.def: Echud, the name of three Israelites

H266.def: an Achochite or descendant of Achoach

H268.gloss: after(-ward), back (part, -side, -ward), hereafter, (be-) hind(-er part), time to come, without.

H270.gloss: [phrase] be affrighted, bar, (catch, lay, take) hold (back), come upon, fasten, handle, portion, (get, have or take) possess(-ion).

H274.def: Achazjah, the name of a Jewish and an Israelite king

H277.def: Achi, the name of two Israelites

H281.def: Achijah, the name of nine Israelites

H283.def: Achio, the name of three Israelites

H285.def: Achitub, the name of several priests

H288.def: Achimelek, the name of an Israelite and of a Hittite

H289.def: Achiman, the name of an Anakite and of an Israelite

H290.def: Achimaats, the name of three Israelites

H293.def: Achinoam, the name of two Israelitesses

H295.def: Achiezer, the name of two Israelites

H298.def: an Achiramite or descendant (collectively) of Achiram
